correctness.rationale: Each binary order-five de Bruijn circle corresponds bijectively to a single 32-orbit feedback permutation F_h(b0,s)=(s,b0 xor h(s)) for one of 2^16 tables; rooting at the unique 00000 removes rotation duplicates. Greedy complete two-letter arches compute the subsequence-universality index, corroborated by independent earliest-subsequence DP in actual checker.py. Independently enumerated all 65536 tables, obtained exactly 2048 full cycles; enumerated all 32 starts for each and found 512 circles with (iota9 at 4 starts,iota10 at 28) and 768+768 circles with (iota10 at 9,iota11 at 23). h(5),h(10) govern length-six alternating factor occurrence, both 1 would form a prohibited two-state cycle. This is exhaustive FINITE proof, not an extrapolation or timed sample.
